description: Section 12.4 staging release stages S0-S7 for the private Product Admin services. Consumed by release-state.mjs (state machine), product-admin-staging-ops.yml (orchestration) and the Section 13.3 staging gate evaluator. A stage is PASSED only with valid staging evidence for the current release commit; local or disposable tests never satisfy a stage, and evidence never carries over to a new commit (prepared host state does; it is re-verified).

stages.title: Reviewed staging code and CI
exit_criteria: Exact commit is the reviewed tip (or an ancestor) of origin/staging
Product Admin Platform CI, Infrastructure Security CI and Monorepo CI succeeded for that commit
Both images built from that commit with recorded sha256 digests

stages.title: Database and network preparation
external_prerequisites: Operator creates DB-A/DB-B migration and runtime roles
Operator writes env and secret files under /etc/cosmicforge/staging
Operator includes the deny snippet in the live Nginx server block
exit_criteria: Four internal networks with policy membership only
DOCKER-USER rules verified
Public probe: no private path answers
Verified pre-migration backup with checksum and restore drill
Preview reports ok, then approved migrations applied
stages.rollback: Forward-only migrations: restore the verified backup (database-migration-runbook.md); networks and firewall rules are removable with prepare-host --remove.

stages.title: Deploy private services
exit_criteria: Exact tested digests running
Live 200; readiness matches the configured activation state
Unauthenticated protocol calls refused
No host port published
stages.rollback: Redeploy the previous recorded digests (pa-staging-ops.sh rollback) or disable (KARRYAM_ADMIN_ENABLED/PIC_ENABLED=false); data and evidence are preserved.

stages.title: Trust enrollment and scoped discovery
external_prerequisites: Karryam Backoffice enrolls the client certificate, HMAC key, staff signing key, issuer/audience and scopes
Signed source owner policy for a READ_ONLY pilot scope
exit_criteria: Discovery reports the actual Bridge capability state
Out-of-scope requests denied by the Bridge
stages.rollback: Revoke enrollment (key revocation runbook); set KARRYAM_BRIDGE_ENABLED=false.

stages.title: Pilot event synchronization
external_prerequisites: Authorized event feed for one pilot partition
exit_criteria: Durable cursor advances only after commit
No integrity hold open
Freshness within the configured target
stages.rollback: KARRYAM_BRIDGE_FEED_ENABLED=false; inbox, cursors and ACK history are kept.

stages.title: Certified resource reads and dashboards
exit_criteria: Dashboards show source freshness/lineage
Missing sources remain null/blocked
No command capability enabled
stages.rollback: Suspend the product or revoke grants through the HQ API.

stages.title: Authorized command-family activation
external_prerequisites: Source owner approval per capability family
exit_criteria: Only approved families listed in KARRYAM_ADMIN_ENABLED_COMMANDS
Every execution has a durable receipt and owner readback
stages.rollback: Remove the family from the allowlist, revoke certification, switch HQ operations off; receipts and audit kept.

stages.title: Legacy shadow comparison and cutover
external_prerequisites: 24-hour observation window (or an independently approved alternative)
exit_criteria: Parity report without unexplained differences
Route-level switch flipped by the owner
24 h observation without regression
stages.rollback: Route-level switch back to legacy (LEGACY_KARRYGO_DISPATCH_MODE=legacy); audit and receipts preserved.
